supplementalCurrentSourceReads.purpose: Real physical responsibility/active defender and pending reach validation; absence of legacy opportunity uses old compatibility return.
SS cache reuse occurs before original callback; first execution samples once, normalizes sample, stores original SS execution.
receivingAvailable is roster-presence metadata. SS builder does not use this property; 2B helper does.
Situation and runnerSettlementIdentity are generated from match moment/cursor/batter, not a frozen new physical slot.
Existing infield family dispatch registration, namespace calls absent from graph edges supplemented by source.
Lifecycle stores source handoff/physical ref, legal routes and context. Active routine lifecycle may already be executing before sampler callback.
Existing SS topology uses original/default or same-physical historical topology; other route owner versions remain separate.
beginExecution replaces executionState with enumerated fields. Future admission/slot pin must be preserved deliberately.

conclusions.canonicalSSUpstream: Secure/reach and first throw are existing distinct authorities. Receiver remains a fielding/sample combined proxy; no new receiver physical authority found in audited owner/cache.
conclusions.receiverAvailability: SS fetches actual roster actor then applies fielding+swing>=3.2; it ignores teammate.receivingAvailable. atBase=true is assigned constant; tagAvailable mirrors receiverReady.
conclusions.identities: Match, cached PA, raw physical contact and handoff identities are reusable facts. Ledger action IDs appear after execution and are ordinal within situation.runnerSettlementIdentity. Throw variation includes route selection ID. Future fixed primaryThrow namespace is a proposed projection, not currently pinned.
conclusions.timing: v1 runner/flight/receiver completion are authoritative old coarse facts. No saved upstream launch/receiver movement/touch origin establishes v2 CRT. v1 ordinal windows are not absolute CRT.
conclusions.sampling: Original owned SS sample is generated only by the original execution callback and retained in cache; no audit execution/callback performed. First throw variations are separate deterministic canonical namespaces, not the SS sample.
conclusions.scopeLimit: The structural negative findings are bounded to the cited SS direct/hold owners and saved fields, not an exhaustive claim about every route or future model.
conclusions.parentFixtureRecommendation: Use original firstBaseFixture / firstBaseIncomingBoundary VM definitions as declared Legacy witnesses only. Empty-base SS normally auto-enters routine execution: pending trap can be executing with sample absent; capture the actual entry before callback and report real lifecycle phase.
